character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a single full-body 16-bit pixel-art character sprite named Rook Boss.

Rook is a thin, slightly scruffy factory foreman in his late 30s. He has a long angular face, tired narrow eyes, heavy eyebrows, a crooked unimpressed mouth, short dark hair, and a worn red-orange baseball cap. His expression should look confident, annoyed, and slightly unhinged.

He wears a dark navy-blue work jacket over an off-white T-shirt, olive-brown work pants with a black belt, a brass key ring hanging from the right side of his belt, and worn brown work boots. He holds a large old red-and-white megaphone in his left hand. His right hand rests on his hip.

Pose him standing in a confident three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. Keep both feet fully visible and planted on the ground. Make the silhouette clean and easy to recognize at small resolution.

Visual style:

- Early-2000s console and PC game 16-bit pixel art
- Muted, aged color palette
- Approximately 64 colors maximum
- Crisp pixel clusters
- Hard pixel edges
- No anti-aliasing
- No smooth gradients
- Limited intentional dithering only
- Strong dark outline
- Simple readable shapes
- Slightly grimy industrial color treatment
- Not vibrant or glossy
- Not photorealistic
- Not 3D
- Not painterly
- Not anime
- Not modern vector art

Animation-readiness requirements:

- Keep the head, torso, arms, hands, legs, feet, hat, key ring, and megaphone visually distinct
- Use simple shapes that can be separated into sprite layers
- Leave clean overlap at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees
- Avoid tiny details that would disappear at sprite resolution
- Keep the face large enough for separate mouth and blink sprites
- Do not crop the character
- Use a transparent background
- Do not include text, logos, scenery, shadows, extra characters, floating body parts, duplicate limbs, or distorted anatomy

rows.animation: looking forward talking and pointing at the screen
